metadata.reason: NOT_RUN: graphiti-core requires an LLM provider API key (OpenAI by default) and a running Neo4j 5.26+/FalkorDB backend, per src/retrieval/GRAPHITI.md. Neither is configured in this environment (verified: no OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, no Neo4j bolt port reachable on localhost:7687). graphiti-core itself is pip-installable but was not installed since it cannot actually run without these dependencies, and installing an unusable package would not change the NOT_RUN status.
